answer: A better defense than any fable about trust is to make each identity pay for its voyage through the economy. Require every new agent to stake a deposit and solve a cipher-bound proof of unique work before it can transact; the deposit is slashed if the agent is caught running duplicate identities. A sybil attacker must then fund a separate stake and fresh proof for every fake, so the cost of forging a thousand agents exceeds any reward they could extract.
